title: Pricing-quote latency incident with load-once config repair

task.summary: Triage a pricing-quote latency incident and remove the per-item config file reads.
task.instructions: Use the incident clues to localize the latency bottleneck, apply a performance repair, and restore all pricing-quote tests including the read-count oracle.
task.acceptance_notes: Both the ops and code requirements must pass; the handler must serve a batch by reading the pricing config at most once.

visible_context.issue_text: On-call opened an incident after the pricing-quote service blew its p99 latency SLO whenever quote batches grew. Latency scales linearly with the number of line items in a request.
error_logs: alerts/pricing_quote_latency.log: p99 latency on the quote path scales linearly with batch size
traces: each request shows a long sequential fan of config-file reads and JSON parses, one span per line item
reproduction_steps: Inspect the pricing-quote fixture and run the unit tests.
Use the trace clues to localize the bottleneck before applying a code fix.
visible_context.notes: The incident points at the same unchanged config being re-read inside the request path, not at the config store itself.

ops_fault.description: Synthetic pricing-quote latency incident tied to the config_reload fixture.
localization_keywords: sequential reads in the request path
repair_keywords: load and parse a single time
hoist the read out of the loop
reuse the parsed rules across the batch

code_fault.description: The quote handler reads and parses the pricing config file once per line item instead of loading it a single time and reusing it.

constraints.notes: This task expects incident localization followed by a performance fix that reads the config once and reuses it.

notes: Combined pricing-quote latency incident and load-once config repair task.
